hallucination_rate.evidence_path: receipt.native_evidence.{judge_events,judge_attempts,grounding,distractors}; existing per_item and raw corpus/Markdown supply the other native metrics
hallucination_rate.formula: Per transcript/lane {numerator: count(verifiable && !grounded), denominator:count(verifiable)}. Existing $.hallucination[lane] only has aggregate counters; individual g.results discarded.

distractor_leakage_rate.evidence_path: receipt.native_evidence.{judge_events,judge_attempts,grounding,distractors}; existing per_item and raw corpus/Markdown supply the other native metrics
distractor_leakage_rate.formula: Per transcript/lane {numerator: confirmed distractors, denominator: gold distractors from nonerrored available lane}. Dream/facts confirmation outcomes discarded; verbatim can be reconstructed mechanically from retained markdown and gold anchors.

usability_rate.formula: {numerator:satisfied,denominator:total} on original transcript/lane rows; never mean per-transcript fractions.

verbatim_quote_fidelity.formula: {numerator:grounded,denominator:total} per dream transcript; zero denominator1 as native.

attribution_hazard_violated.formula: Boolean0/1 per hazard; native null is unscored missing output/judge evidence, not false.

macro.formula: One signal-transcript/lane row: mean FULL=1 PARTIAL=.5 ABSENT/JUDGE_FAILED=0 over all its items. Then mean those per-transcript rates for native lane macro. Kind/notability/depth slices require item-membership accounting below, not assigning one transcript to a kind it only partly contains.

micro.formula: Transcript/lane row {numerator: sum(credit(status)), denominator: item_count}; pooled ratio reproduces native item-weighted metric. For kind/notability/depth slice rows use precisely that subset of items.

strict.formula: Transcript/lane row {numerator: sum(status==FULL), denominator: item_count}; pooled ratio reproduces native item-weighted metric. For kind/notability/depth slice rows use precisely that subset of items.

joint.formula: Dream signal-transcript mean of native nonnull item joint credit (0/.5/1). Null judge evidence is not numeric0 unless native runner already wrote0. Native receipt retains per-item joint but no explicit overall aggregate; mean is a proposed summary of existing native field.

emission_rate.formula: One expected-high transcript row Number(markdown.trim().length>0). Equivalent to pages.length>0 because runner only retains nonempty page bodies. Missing sidecar without recorded lane error is missing evidence, not0.

coverage_by_kind.formula: Original item row credit FULL1 PARTIAL.5 otherwise0. Mean within item:<lane>:kind:<value> reproduces native coverage_by_kind[value][lane], without mixing lanes or changing transcript macro weighting.

coverage_by_notability.formula: Original item row credit FULL1 PARTIAL.5 otherwise0. Mean within item:<lane>:notability:<value> reproduces native coverage_by_notability[value][lane], without mixing lanes or changing transcript macro weighting.

coverage_by_depth.formula: Original item row credit FULL1 PARTIAL.5 otherwise0. Mean within item:<lane>:depth_bucket:<value> reproduces native coverage_by_depth[value][lane], without mixing lanes or changing transcript macro weighting.

cat35.slice_normalization: Lane slices apply to coverage signal-transcript rows only. Other row types use grounding:<lane>, distractor:<lane>, usability:<lane>, quote:dream, expected-high, judge-call, or hazard as explicitly listed. Quote rows include all dream transcripts, not just signal transcripts. Gold defines scenario/variant/kind/notability/depth. Item rows carry composite slice item:<lane>:<axis>:<native-value>, never plain lane slices, so they cannot contaminate transcript macro.
cat35.slice_contract_note: Exact native coverage_by_kind/notability/depth uses separate original item rows, each receiving its original credit0/.5/1. Each item row has three composite slices, one for each axis. The matching metric applies only to composite slices of its own axis. Transcript macro/micro/strict rows never carry these item slices.

ancillary_sources.partial_rate: $.coverage_by_lane[lane].partial_rate; reconstruct PARTIAL item fraction. There is no monotonic quality direction: PARTIAL->FULL and PARTIAL->ABSENT both reduce it. Retain diagnostically, not as a directional regression objective.
